description: Reads one Check by its id, as stored (status, target, seal, result, screening, networks, events), with access, the proof of the wallet that paid it (without it check_payer_proof_required, 401). A Check still awaiting the Crystal report can include partialReport with the delivered readings. Never calls a paid provider. An unknown id, or one paid by another wallet than the proof's, gets check_not_found (404).

access.description: The proof of the wallet that paid this Check: its Check access from check_access (vca_..., 24 hours) or its purchase proof from check_buy_proof (vcb_..., 10 minutes, the one you hold right after buying). Secret. Sent as the Authorization header, never in the body.

checkId.description: The Check id from check_charge (CHK-...). Keep it private: with the payer's proof (access) it analyses and reads this Check.

name: check_result
